newsitem.title: USA: Hudson Hotels to buy 9 hotels for $47 mln.
newsitem.headline: Hudson Hotels to buy 9 hotels for $47 mln.

text.p: Hudson Hotels Corp said Wednesday that it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire nine Hampton Inns from a subsidiary of Equity Inns Inc for $47,250,000.

Hudson Hotels said the nine hotels have annual revenues of about $16 million, and will boost its annual revenues to about $55 million. They contain a total of 1,089 hotel rooms, giving Hudson 41 hotels under management with 4,625 rooms.
The company also said it will seek to buy more Hampton Inn properties.
It said the transaction is subject to final due diligence and specific contract negotiation. Closing is expected prior to October 1.
Hudson Hotels develops and manages hotel properties for its own account, as well as through partnerships and joint ventures.
